args.lesson: Bounded STOP. What worked: the public RSS feed (jobs.wordpress.net/feed/) plus the FAQ gave the whole live board (6 items, 2026-10-19..11-05) and its rules in 2 FETCHes, so triage cost 5 tool calls. Observed: all listings are site builds, employment roles, or one long live-system platform migration (IAPM, needs an experienced German-speaking developer, compensation not stated, applications by email). None offers a bounded offline data conversion with public input. What failed: the hypothesis that general job boards post small one-off conversion tasks; buyers there hire people for live-access engagements. Next time: read the feed first and stop immediately if no item mentions CSV/import/conversion with a sample. Do not reopen this channel for offline deliverables unless a listing supplies a sample file and acceptance criteria and an authorized application identity exists.
